name: Velocity-Matched UI Sting Story Film
description: A narrative video skill for turning a software workflow into a fast, memorable social brand film. It choreographs interface fragments, counters, proof bars, and end-card typography around one motion language. Use it for launches, campaign cutdowns, and product stories that need a distinctive visual signature.
whatYouGet: A 20–45 second narrative MP4 with hook, problem, product, proof, and end card
A multi-scene HTML/CSS source composition rendered locally without generation models
Velocity-matched cuts with a consistent easing family and directional motion system
A saturated grid visual system with kinetic UI panels and clear social-safe typography
goodFit: Product launches that need a concise, ownable motion identity
Social campaigns explaining a workflow improvement in under one minute
Software brands with a measurable outcome and a few visualizable capabilities
notFor: Feature inventories that need dense explanatory copy
Campaigns whose central idea depends on photography, people, or live-action footage
Quiet editorial films with restrained or ambient motion
requiredInputs: A fictional or approved product name and promise
The workflow problem the film should make tangible
Two to four product moments or capabilities
One proof metric, benchmark, or customer outcome

faq.q: Can the film use a real product interface?
faq.a: Yes. Supply approved interface labels and visual references, but keep the composition focused on a few legible states rather than reproducing an entire product.

faq.q: How much copy fits in the film?
faq.a: The format favors short headlines, compact UI labels, and one proof statement. Longer explanations should be converted into visual state changes or moved into the accompanying post copy.

faq.q: Can the same film be adapted for other social formats?
faq.a: Yes. The source keeps key typography and metrics inside a defined safe zone, making square and portrait reframing practical during finishing.

demoPrompt: /sl-velocity-matched-ui-sting-story-film Create a 22-second 16:9 brand film for fictional workflow product Relayform. Open with “MOMENTUM, WITHOUT THE MAZE”; show requests, delayed handoffs and a unified review flow, then the “42% shorter” proof, time-back bars and a ready-to-move checklist. Close with “Move the work forward.” Use a saturated orange ground, dark mono UI panels, a fixed technical grid and velocity-matched horizontal cuts.
followUpPrompts: Make the problem scene more tense while keeping all copy under six words per headline.
Replace the proof bars with a counter and a compact checklist, preserving the same motion direction.
Create a square-safe reframing plan that keeps the metric and end card fully legible.
externalCostNote: No external services or generation models. Renders locally.
